whyItMatters: An ingress rule open to 0.0.0.0/0 exposes the port to the entire internet, and scanners find such ports within hours.
actions: Identify the genuine callers of the flagged port (office, VPN, load balancer).
Replace 0.0.0.0/0 with those exact CIDRs or with referencing security-group IDs.
Apply, verify connectivity from the allowed networks only, and add an IaC lint check against 0.0.0.0/0.
verification: The finding disappears on rescan and the port is unreachable from outside the allow-list.
